_comment: Slack App manifest for Foundry by Gitwork. Source of truth for the app's scopes + URLs. Copy the contents (minus this _comment field, Slack rejects unknown top-level keys) into https://api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From an app manifest. Scope changes ship via PRs against this file; the Settings → Integrations page renders the manifest as a copy block.

display_information.name: Foundry by Gitwork
display_information.description: Foundry's standup, roll-up and client-channel automation for the Gitwork team.
display_information.long_description: Foundry posts the daily standup as rich Block Kit cards (with task drill-down, mark-done, add-comment), publishes the DevOps roll-up, and provisions per-client internal + Slack Connect channels when a new client is onboarded. All credentials live in Foundry's Settings → Integrations panel; nothing is stored client-side.
